rationale: C05 is a highly plausible immediate drafting template. Both letters accept a Cabinet officer's resignation effective January 20, 1961; praise the officer and departmental staff; summarize concrete departmental accomplishments drawn from the officer's report; thank the officer for national service; and close with nearly identical wishes for health and happiness upon leaving government. The close dates and extensive parallel structure and phrasing go materially beyond routine resignation-letter boilerplate. C06 shares much of the same end-of-administration template, while C01 is especially relevant as an earlier resignation letter for the same department and discusses the Highway Program, but neither matches C05 as closely overall.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Commerce, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to pay tribute to you and your excellent staff.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am accepting your resignation, effective January 20, 1961, and in so doing I wish to pay tribute to your dedication and management skill, and to the valuable services of your fine staff.
shared_material.explanation: Near-identical operative sentence combining acceptance, the same effective date, personal tribute, and praise for departmental staff.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Among the many significant accomplishments of your Department these past eight years, two deserve special mention
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Particularly do I wish to thank you for your fine report of achievements of your Department. You have introduced outstanding improvements in the postal service
shared_material.explanation: Both letters move from acceptance and tribute into a report-based catalogue of departmental achievements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you point out in your report
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive mirrored wording explicitly attributes quantified accomplishments to the departing officer's report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For these activities, as well as the broad range of other functions you have supervised, you have my appreciation and thanks.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I thank you for these services to the Nation
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the achievements section with direct thanks for the officer's services.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you leave government service, I wish you health and happiness in the years to come. With warm regard, As ever
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You have my very best wishes for the future as you return to private life. May good health and happiness be yours in the years ahead. With warm regard, As ever
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel farewell language and identical complimentary close reinforce the shared template.
